sources.title: Shopify Help Center: Shopify Payments fees

keyLimits.en: 2.9% + $0.30 per online credit card transaction on the Basic Shopify plan; +1% for cards issued outside the merchant's country
2.4-2.5% + $0.30 per online credit card transaction, the lowest tier rate

cautions.en: Shopify Payments is not a standalone product; its transaction rate depends entirely on which Shopify store plan (Basic/Shopify/Advanced) the merchant subscribes to.
Using Shopify Payments removes Shopify's separate third-party payment gateway fee (0.6% to 2% depending on plan), which otherwise applies on top of any external processor's own fees.
Cards issued outside the merchant's own country add a further 1% surcharge; premium cards (e.g. Amex, corporate, high-rewards) may carry different rates.

capabilities.en: Built-in payment processing for Shopify stores: cards, digital wallets, installments, and crypto payment acceptance.
Supports 130+ currencies and integrates with Shop Pay accelerated checkout.

limitations.en: Only available to merchants running a Shopify store; not usable as a standalone payment processor outside Shopify.
Transaction rate is tied to the merchant's Shopify subscription tier rather than being independently negotiable at the entry tiers.

reason.en: General-purpose payment processor that can also power e-commerce checkouts outside Shopify's own gateway.
Alternative payment processing platform for online commerce, though more India-market focused.

unknowns: In-person (POS) card rates were not confirmed in this pass, only online transaction rates.
Exact surcharge for premium/corporate cards is not quantified on the fetched pages.
